rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Announcements, Tablings and Committee Reports No 6 of Monday 9 June 2014 record that 'A letter dated 30 May 2014 has been received from the President of the Republic' informing members of the Assembly that he has appointed 'the Deputy President of the Republic, Mr M C Ramaphosa', as Leader of Government Business in the National Assembly under section 91(4) of the Constitution.

bounded_scope: Deputy President observations for CLAUDE-C01-21 only (role za_deputy_president in za_presidency).
